name: Twilight Syndrome i
summary:
Twilight Syndrome i is a mobile horror adventure game developed for NTT DoCoMo's i-mode service and released in Japan in December 2002.

Based on Twilight Syndrome: Saikai for the PlayStation, the game features an original scenario created by members of the original development team. Players follow Yuri and her companions as they investigate mysterious rumors and supernatural occurrences.
